_changelog: Nov 1: invite_chip.png added (Home chip inviting existing saves to the warm-up; matches px/eib/invite.png).

Nov 1 (Kai): moment 3 chirps made listen-only. New chirp_same_<side> (identical, level sound lines) + chirp_reveal_<side> (+_static), named to match warmup.js hooks; both sides on perch_low.png. chirp_high_*, chirp_low_*, perch_high kept but deprecated (warmup.js fallback).

layout._moment3: listen-only: both chirps use chirp_same_<side> at chirp_low_<side>, both perches perch_low.png at perch_low_<side>; chirp_high_*/perch_high are deprecated

files.frames: cols c d e f g a b f# bb (echoback.js COLS); row0 rest, row1 pressed/lit
files.use: Moment 1 'copy two notes': two 48x48 pads (sol + mi of the family). Same shapes/colours as the EIB pads.

files.frames: cols heart, paw, wing, clap; row0 rest, row1 pressed
files.use: Moment 2 heartbeat (heart col) and moment 4 'clap it back' (paw = Howlings/Purrlings, wing = Wingsongs, clap = optional alt).

files.frames: f0 rest, f1 thump, f2 settle (80x80 cells)
files.use: Moment 2 heartbeat aura, drawn BEHIND the Echo sprite, centred on its body. One thump per beat.
Reduced-motion heartbeat aura (no pulsing; pair with heart_beat_static).

files.frames: f0 small (between beats), f1 big (on the beat) (13x13 cells)
files.use: Little heart floating above the Echo head in moment 2 (in front of everything). Beats with the glow.
Reduced-motion heart above the Echo.

files.frames: f0 idle, f1 chirp (open beak, LEVEL sound lines), f2 happy (28x28 cells)
files.use: Moment 3 (listen-only): the chirp on the LEFT side (faces right). Identical on both sides; pitch is heard only. Use f2 on ANY tap (both sides).
Reduced motion: show while that chirp sounds, f0 otherwise.
Reveal after the tap: put this on the HIGHER chirp and run the .hop (translateY up ~5px, once). The lower one stays on chirp_same f2.

files.frames: single (body raised 4px inside the cell + sparkle)
files.use: Reduced-motion reveal for the HIGHER chirp: no hop; the raised pose shows it went up. Hold ~800 ms.

files.use: Optional strip at top showing which little moment is on. Never filled/ticked as "done" (not progress, not a score).
Soft warm light on the stump top under the Echo (behind sprite). Static.
Rhythm row on the first-song card: one mark per tap of the child's rhythm (short vs long by SHAPE).
Memory Book 'Our first song' card art (112x64). Code draws the child's 2 notes in the slots and beat marks in the rhythm row; tap = play.
Same card while the first song plays (swap in, swap back at the end). Static frame, no motion needed.
Small 24x24 sticker/icon for the Memory Book list or page tab.

files.use: Home invite chip for existing saves with no warm-up: egg + note, no words. Same size/frame as px/eib/invite.png: use on the .wuinv button (background-image:url(px/warmup/invite_chip.png)); all other .eibinv rules (40x40, pixelated, bob, fade, .rm) unchanged.
